messages:
rachel: Quick idea for a compact experiment: 20-min micro-demo + 2-day credit drip for new signups. Goal = faster time-to-first-success (TTFS). Split test: rapid-onboard vs empathy-led onboarding.
diego: Love it. Rapid = product-first prompts + single-click sample app. Empathy = use-case stories + guided template. We need clear success metric.
evan_marketing: Metrics: TTFS (time to run first prompt), 48h activation rate, and demo->paid conversion at 30 days. Can we tag users by 'funnel=microA|microB'?
sarah_sdr: For routing: if email domain is company and tokens > 500 in 7 days, queue to SDR with priority high. Otherwise, automated nurture. SLA: first SDR ping <=6h.
ops-bot: Routing created. Example event mapping: ```json
{"event":"signup","props":{"utm":"microA","assign":"cohort_microA"}}
```
Will emit webhook to #sales-inbound.
rachel: Copy angles draft: microA (rapid): 'Get a working LLM demo in 20 minutes. Claim 2-day seed credits.' microB (empathy): 'See how teams cut inference cost 2x — real customer stories + guided prompts.' CTA variants: 'Try demo' vs 'See case study + credits'.
diego: Channel plan: LinkedIn short post + email blast to dev list + in-product banner. Registration page needs a compact checklist + one-click sample app. Evan can we A/B the CTA on page?
evan_marketing: Yep. I'll set variants and attach utm_source=mini_demo_{variant}. Also will add a small microsurvey on success signal: 'Did you get expected output?' yes/no.
sarah_sdr: SDR script for qualified leads: quick intro, offer 30-min workshop, remind credits expire in 48h. Use template: "Congrats on demo — want help connecting to your stack?"
rachel: Onboarding artifact: 3 micro-templates per funnel. Rapid pack: minimal system prompt, short example, single retrieval snippet. Empathy pack: use-case intro + longer examples + hand-holding notes. Add to /docs/mini-demo/pack-1744444444.md
ops-bot: Tracking snippet for credit drip: `<script>emit('credit_grant',{cohort:'microA',amount:2000});</script>` include after signup flow.
evan_marketing: Timeline: creatives + landing by Fri EOD, routing live Mon, micro-demo live Tue, credit drip active Tue. Who's presenting the 20-min demo?
diego: I can demo the retrieval flow and cost-savings. rachel — can you cover quickstart and prompts?
rachel: Yup. Also want a short FAQ for the landing: billing, private deployments, SLA note. Keep it minimal.
sarah_sdr: One ask: include a hidden field on registration 'use_case' so we can tailor first outreach.
evan_marketing: Good call. Will add. Ill post the final copy in this thread when ready. :smiley:
